verdict: Paid leads are cheap and plentiful this period, but weak organic presence and static creative cap the upside.
diagnosis: Cost per lead sits near $12.92 this period — roughly a tenth of the legal industry benchmark — but Instagram following and intake visibility stay thin.

signals.headline: 669 leads at $12.92 each
signals.detail: Paid Instagram generated 669 lead actions this period at an average of $12.92 — well below legal norms.

signals.headline: 3,881 landing page views logged
signals.detail: Landing page views reached 3,881 against 5,038 link clicks, pointing to a roughly 23% drop-off before the page loads.

signals.headline: 74 new reviews, 4.9 stars
signals.detail: Google Business Profile added 74 reviews this period at a 4.9 average. Strong social proof asset going unused in ads.

signals.headline: Only 47 Instagram followers
signals.detail: Organic Instagram sits at 47 followers with 44 profile visits. Paid is doing all the work; organic is invisible.

signals.headline: 296 call clicks from Google
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove 296 call clicks and 79 direction requests. Local presence is converting, not just impressing.

recommendations.title: Test video versions of the winning static ad
recommendations.detail: Consider shooting two 15-second video variants of 'Paid Fees, But No Relief?' Video typically outperforms static in legal. Keep the hook and headline identical for a clean test.

recommendations.title: Push more budget while cost per lead is this low
recommendations.detail: At $12.92 per lead against an $18 category benchmark, there is headroom. Worth exploring a 25–40% budget lift before auction costs catch up.

recommendations.title: Feature 4.9-star reviews inside ad creative
recommendations.detail: 74 fresh reviews this period are untapped. Test a creative showing the star rating and a short quote. Social proof lifts conversion in legal.
